summary: EyeGuard iteration 3 (Stripe subscription + owner-controlled Paid Mode + Sponsor/Interstitial ad monetization + 16-language i18n). Backend: 28/28 pytest passed - all Pro/Admin/Checkout/Stats/Settings + NEW Ads endpoints (GET/PUT /api/ads/sponsor with admin-gated PUT, POST /api/ads/impression, POST /api/ads/click, GET /api/ads/stats with correct math ctr + estimated_earnings=impressions/1000*2.0+clicks*0.05). Frontend fully verified end-to-end on mobile viewport (390x844): (1) Owner panel entry - 5-tap on Settings title opens /admin, unlock with 142536 works, paid-mode-toggle + sponsor-toggle + Ad Earnings tile (impressions/clicks/CTR/est. earnings) + sponsor form (title/subtitle/image_url/link/save) all present. Sponsor + paid mode reset to OFF at end so default UX is free.

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — originates from a third-party lib (BlurView / LinearGradient / expo-router). Same as iteration_2; upstream migration pending.

action_items: Nothing critical. Optional: in /app/frontend/app/interstitial.tsx the api.adImpression() useEffect fires once per mount, but React strict-mode / hot-reload in web preview may double-fire it in dev; you can guard with a ref to make impression tracking strictly once-per-mount if that matters for reporting.
Optional (already noted in iteration_2): investigate library source of 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_sponsor rebuilds a Sponsor by iterating Sponsor.model_fields — works with pydantic v2; keep in mind field-defaults leak if a new field is added.
ads_config document holds both 'sponsor' and 'metrics' shapes keyed by _id; safe but note the collection is polymorphic.
Sponsor PUT uses partial merge via {exclude_unset=True} which is correct; no code needed to change.
Consider rate-limiting /api/ads/impression + /api/ads/click since they are unauthenticated public endpoints (could be inflated). Currently acceptable for MVP but worth noting for production.
